sections.title: Release readiness
sections.sql: select project,locale,total,ready,blocked from release_readiness order by project,locale

sections.title: Overdue follow-ups
sections.sql: select name,owner,due,project,key from overdue_tasks order by due

sections.title: Strings needing a decision
sections.sql: select * from translation_status where state<>'ready' order by project,key,locale

sections.title: Evidence to check
sections.sql: select record,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,record
